title: Google Assistant will shut down for good on Android and Wear OS in September — here's what you need to do…
excerpt: Google has confirmed that Google Assistant will stop working on Android and Wear OS in the near future.
content_html:
• We're saying goodbye to Google Assistant on more devices
  • September 4 is the cut-off point for Android and Wear OS
  • The process of switching over to Gemini is pretty seamless

Google Assistant had a good run — it made its debut in May 2016 as part of the Allo app (remember that?) — but Gemini is very much the future when it comes to Google-made AI helpers, and now we finally know when Google Assistant will stop working on Android phones and Wear OS wearables.

As per emails sent out to some Google Assistant users (via 9to5Google), the Android and Wear OS shutdown will begin on Friday, September 4. From that point, it may take a few weeks to reach every user and every device.

It means you won't be able to use Google Assistant at all on Android phones, tablets, and paired wearables. This will apply to Android Auto too, though vehicles with Google built-in, Google Assistant will carry on functioning for a little longer.

The cut-off point was originally scheduled for sometime last year, before being extended, but it now looks as though this is final. Google has been busy making Gemini the default choice on a multitude of gadgets in recent months, including smart home devices and Google TV streamers.

What to do next

If you're still using Google Assistant on Android or Wear OS, you need to move over to Gemini at your earliest opportunity. If it didn't already come preinstalled on your device, you can get it from the Google Play Store. A whole new world of AI awaits, covering everything from basic phone commands to image creation.

When you're setting up Gemini, it will guide you through the process of replacing Google Assistant as the default on-board AI. As you're using the same Google account for both apps, the switch should be pretty seamless.

Google Assistant doesn't really keep a chat archive, so there's nothing to sync over in terms of conversations. If you want to see your old Google Assistant interactions, they'll still be available via the Web & App Activity page in your Google account.

You can carry on using the old Google Assistant commands with Gemini, including the "hey Google" alert phrase that gets the AI to listen for instructions. Everything should work as before — though there have been some issues along the way — and your Gemini conversations will be synced between devices by default.

content_html_zh:
• 我们将在更多设备上告别 Google Assistant
  • 9 月 4 日是 Android 和 Wear OS 的分界点
  • 切换到 Gemini 的过程非常顺利

Google Assistant 表现良好——它于 2016 年 5 月作为 Allo 应用程序的一部分首次亮相（还记得吗？）——但就 Google 制造的人工智能助手而言，Gemini 非常有前途，现在我们终于知道 Google Assistant 何时停止在 Android 手机和 Wear OS 可穿戴设备上工作。

根据发送给一些 Google Assistant 用户的电子邮件（通过 9to5Google），Android 和 Wear OS 将于 9 月 4 日星期五开始关闭。 从那时起，可能需要几周的时间才能到达每个用户和每台设备。

这意味着您将无法在 Android 手机、平板电脑和配对的可穿戴设备上使用 Google Assistant。 这也适用于 Android Auto，不过内置 Google 的车辆，Google Assistant 将继续运行一段时间。

截止点原定于去年某个时候，后来被延长，但现在看来这似乎是最终决定。 近几个月来，谷歌一直忙于让 Gemini 成为众多小工具的默认选择，包括智能家居设备和谷歌电视流媒体。

接下来做什么

如果您仍在 Android 或 Wear OS 上使用 Google Assistant，则需要尽早转向 Gemini。 如果您的设备上尚未预装该软件，您可以从 Google Play 商店获取。 一个全新的人工智能世界正在等待着您，涵盖从基本的电话命令到图像创建的所有内容。

当您设置 Gemini 时，它将引导您完成将 Google Assistant 替换为默认车载 AI 的过程。 由于您对这两个应用程序使用相同的 Google 帐户，因此切换应该非常无缝。

Google Assistant 并没有真正保存聊天档案，因此在对话方面没有任何内容可以同步。 如果您想查看旧的 Google Assistant 交互，仍然可以通过 Google 帐户中的网络和应用活动页面进行访问。

订阅突发新闻、评论、观点、顶级技术交易等。

您可以继续使用 Gemini 的旧 Google Assistant 命令，包括让 AI 听取指令的“嘿 Google”警报短语。 一切都应该像以前一样工作——尽管一路上出现了一些问题——并且默认情况下，你的 Gemini 对话将在设备之间同步。

在 Google 新闻上关注 TechRadar，并将我们添加为首选来源，以便在您的 Feed 中获取我们的专家新闻、评论和意见。

Dave 是一名自由科技记者，二十多年来一直致力于撰写有关小工具、应用程序和网络的文章。 他居住在英国斯托克波特，在 TechRadar 上您会发现他报道新闻、专题和评论，尤其是手机、平板电脑和可穿戴设备方面的新闻、专题和评论。 为了确保我们周末的突发新闻报道是业内最好的，David 还在 Gizmodo、T3、PopSci 和其他一些地方发表署名，并多年来编辑 PC Explorer 和 The Hardware Handbook 等书籍。
